---
title: "Was It AI, or Was It Interest Rates?"
description: "Separating AI from the rate shock and post-pandemic correction in tech hiring, 2019-2026"
toc: false
---

From their peak in March 2022 to August 2026, job postings in AI-exposed sectors fell by roughly 67 percent, while postings in control sectors fell by roughly 36 percent and recovered above their pre-pandemic level. This project asks how much of that gap AI explains, and how much belongs to higher interest rates and the correction of pandemic-era overhiring. It works from five data sources covering 2019 to 2026, including 56,334 job postings.

## What this project covers

- Data preparation and exploratory analysis — complete
- Clustering and PCA — complete
- Naive Bayes and decision trees — to come
- Regression — to come
- AdaBoost, gradient boosting and XGBoost — to come
